# MediaCC

> MediaCC is a free browser-based image and video converter. Selected media files are processed locally on the user's device and are not uploaded to MediaCC servers for conversion.

## Main tools

- Image converter: https://www.mediacc.it.com/image
- Video converter: https://www.mediacc.it.com/video
- HEIC to JPG: https://www.mediacc.it.com/image/heic-to-jpg
- HEIC to PNG: https://www.mediacc.it.com/image/heic-to-png
- WebP to JPG: https://www.mediacc.it.com/image/webp-to-jpg
- MOV to MP4: https://www.mediacc.it.com/video/mov-to-mp4
- WebM to MP4: https://www.mediacc.it.com/video/webm-to-mp4

## Product facts

- Image outputs focus on JPG, PNG, and WebP.
- Video conversion uses FFmpeg WebAssembly in supported modern browsers.
- Users can process up to 15 files per session, 150 MB per file, and 1000 MB total.
- No account is required and MediaCC does not add a watermark.
